<function name="SetMatrix" parent="IMaterial" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the specified material value to the specified matrix, does nothing on a type mismatch.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="materialMatrix" type="string">The name of the material int.</arg>
		<arg name="matrix" type="VMatrix">The new matrix.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
